blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Rather than relying on importation as a quick fix for feed deficits, the government must address deep structural issues in the corn sector, including degraded soil and flawed regional planning, a lawmaker here said. Agusan del Sur 2nd District Rep. Adolph Edward “Eddiebong” Plaza assailed the Department of Agriculture’s (DA) corn importation policy during last week’s hearing by the House Committee on Agriculture and Food.
